title: Percona: scale-out remove (graceful Galera leave)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove percona <node>`: stops nexus-percona on a non-writer PXC node so it gracefully leaves Galera (ProxySQL marks it offline). Refuses the current writer.

observe.what: gracefully left pxc-node-1 (service stopped; ProxySQL marks it offline; ready for re-add)

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync gracefully drains a Galera member with a writer-guard (refuses the current ProxySQL writer).
